title: docs(types): correct the `series` and route-overview docblocks PRs #10802 and #10821 made false (objectui#10905)
body:
Fixes #10905

Clause-②: no — comment and describe text only; no accept set or public surface moves.

## What changed

Two docblocks in `packages/types/src`, comment text only, plus an empty-frontmatter changeset. No `.describe()` string, type, value or accept set moves.

1. **`ObjectChartSchema.series`, the TS interface in `objectql.ts`.** The sentence "A `type` written on this arm anyway is an excess property on a literal typed by this interface" is replaced. Since PR #10802 (objectui#10770), each `series` entry is either the spec's `ChartSeries` (the `{ name }` arm) or the internal `{ dataKey }` arm. The `{ name }` arm declares `type`, and excess-property checking on that union accepts a key that either arm declares, provided the value fits that declaration. So `{ dataKey: 'amount', type: 'line' }` compiles. The zod half of the paragraph (a plain `z.object`, which strips `type`, so the entry parses clean and the key is dropped) is still true and is kept. "The mirror's `.describe()` says the same" now reads "names the same omission". The `.describe()` string names the omission and never made the excess-property claim, so it is not touched.
2. **The route overview headed "WHERE THIS ARM IS INSTALLED", in `zod/objectql.zod.ts`.** Its second-route paragraph made three claims. It said a named view's `listViews` "is unmirrored". It said `generateViewSchema` merges the same two nestings. It named a `custom` issue at `listViews.KEY.options.kanban.groupBy`. Since PR #10821 (objectui#7928), `listViews` is `stripImportedDefaults(SpecViewSchema).shape.listViews`. That record refuses a named view's `options` bag whole, `generateViewSchema` reads no `options` bag, and `checkNamedViewKanbanStrayGroupBy` reports at `listViews.KEY.kanban.groupBy` only. The heading ("TWO NESTINGS EACH") and the final sentence ("cannot depend on which route or nesting") described the same pre-#10821 shape, so they are corrected in the same docblock. Three nestings now take the one string. A named view's `options.kanban.groupBy` meets the protocol's refusal of `options` instead.

Route 1 of the overview (`list-view`: `kanban` plus `options.kanban`) was re-read against `ListView` and `ListViewSchema.options` and is unchanged.

## Measurements

The probes are kept outside the tree and were run once. Everything was measured on `733fd5ac6`.

**Sentence 1, a `tsc` probe.** Three literals typed `ObjectChartSchema`, run under the package's own tsconfig:
- `series: [{ dataKey: 'amount', type: 'line' }]` produced no diagnostic, so the sentence under test is false.
- Positive control: `series: [{ dataKey: 'amount', zzzUnknownKey: 1 }]` produced TS2353 ("Object literal may only specify known properties"), so a genuinely unknown key IS refused.
- Value control: `series: [{ dataKey: 'amount', type: 'not-a-chart-family' }]` produced TS2322, so the value must fit the spec's `ChartType`.

**The zod half, a parse probe** (`ObjectChartSchema.safeParse`):
- `{ dataKey: 'amount', type: 'line' }` succeeds with series `[{"dataKey":"amount"}]`, so the key is stripped and that half stays true.
- Controls: `{ dataKey, chartType: 'line' }` keeps `chartType`, and `{ name, type: 'line' }` keeps `type`.

**Sentence 2, a parse probe** (`ObjectViewSchema.safeParse`, a named view carrying `columns` and `kanban.columns`):
- `kanban.groupBy` gives `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.board.kanban` naming `groupBy`, plus `custom` at `listViews.board.kanban.groupBy`.
- `options.kanban.groupBy` gives only `unrecognized_keys` at `listViews.board` naming `options`. There is no `custom` under `options`.
- Dark control (`groupByField` and `columns` only): success.
- `generateViewSchema` reads no `options` bag: a `.options` read pattern hits `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView.tsx` zero times, and hits `plugin-list`'s `ListView.tsx` (the positive control) 48 times.

**Lit control.** I extracted each of the `checkNamedViewKanbanStrayGroupBy` and `namedViewKindRefusals` docblocks, from its opening line through the declaration line, before and after the edit. Both are byte-identical: `cmp` is silent, and the sha256 prefixes are `aaa003254ab7127a` and `7c8aa1b4f5cd6a3d` on both sides.

## Changeset

On the docblock commit alone, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` answered exit 1, because both files are published source of `@object-ui/types`. So a declaration is owed.

The declaration uses empty frontmatter, not `patch`. Nothing a consumer acts on moves. Both docblocks reach the build output only as comment text: after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`, the new `series` sentence is in `dist/objectql.d.ts` and the route overview is in the zod module's JS. At the time of writing, both changes that made the sentences false (PR #10802 and PR #10821) are still pending changesets, so no release has carried the false text.

## Gates

I derived these by hand from the root `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`, because the objectstack `dispatch-gates.mjs` does not cover this repository.

At head `950bf6406`:
- Exit 0 for all of these: `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check-changeset-presence` (empty-frontmatter pass), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-spec-symbol-derivation`, `check-handler-key-read-sites` and `check-unreferenced-sources`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: 264 files and 5854 tests passed, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the three script tests that read `objectql.zod.ts` as text (`check-eager-closure-budget`, `check-handler-key-read-sites` and `vite-types-zod-lazy`): 3 files and 241 tests passed, exit 0.

At `7449bc6a9`, which differs from the head only in the changeset's wording (`git diff --stat` shows one file under `.changeset/`):
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` exit 0, and the dist completeness check reported complete.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` exit 0, with 0 errors.

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the three paths answered NOT GOVERNED.

NOT MEASURED:
- `check:eager-closure`, reason: it reads every package's built dist, and a comment-only diff moves no import edge. Its script test above ran green.
- A downstream consumer type-check, reason: the `.d.ts` changes JSDoc text only, and no type bytes move.

Known repo-wide red, left alone: `Spec Main Shape Gate` (objectui#10916, owned by another seat).

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing pins either half of the corrected `series` sentence: a `type` on a `{ dataKey }` entry compiles, and the mirror strips it. The probes above were run once. This is an observation, not filed. Carrier: none.
- `main` has not moved from `733fd5ac6` on either file. PR #10927 edits `objectql.zod.ts` at its imports and its tail, which are disjoint from this docblock.

Implemented by the dispatched dev run of the `domain:spec` seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm`.
